The '''Imperial Records Office''' was a department responsible for maintaining various records of import to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] managed to infiltrate their [[Imperial military communications complex|facility]] on [[Galvoni III]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into restricted [[Computer/Legends|computer]] files there to acquire an overview of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] and its crew, only narrowly escaping.
